name: Sushi Noz
dinnerNote: Edomae omakase, paid in full when booking

menus.name: Edomae omakase
menus.note: 5–6 small plates, then 12–14 nigiri, miso soup, tamago and dessert; paid in full when booking, gratuity not included. Same menu at the 8-seat Hinoki Counter (Chef Noz Monday to Friday at 6pm and 9pm) and the 6-seat Ash Room (5:45pm and 8:45pm). Signature and Prestige drink pairings of sake, champagne and white wine are offered (prices not published)

alsoTry.name: Noz Market
alsoTry.note: The group's market and restaurant on Third Avenue at 78th Street, with a hand roll counter for walk-ins and an 11-seat omakase counter, open for lunch and dinner every day

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, which takes the full $550 per person when booking. On 13 October 2026 dates up to 30 November were open and December was not yet released. When a seating is full you can send a request for another time.
cancellation: The meal is paid in full when booking. Cancel or reschedule at least 72 hours ahead for a refund less a 3% fee; within 72 hours the whole payment is lost. A booking can be rescheduled twice, and a third change counts as a cancellation.
groups: Parties of more than four book the whole counter: the Hinoki Counter seats up to eight and the Ash Room up to six. Call the restaurant or email reservations@sushinoz.com for buyout prices; separate bookings for one party count as a buyout.
dressCode: No dress code is published. Guests are asked to keep perfume and cologne light.
duration: About two and a half hours.
